title: Navajo skinwalker lore matches ranch activity

tellings.quote: Cuz I was doing a little Googling and it was like talking about luminous objects,

plain: Old Navajo stories about skinwalkers, the figures of Navajo lore that the ranch is named after, are said to describe things like "luminous objects", much like what people report at Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for claims of strange lights and events. Michels says he found this while "doing a little Googling" and raises it with the ranch's owner. If the match holds, it would suggest the activity there goes back long before anyone owned the land.
